Alyson, saw Stampli land the 2026 FrontRunners nod and keep scaling off the Blackstone-led round.

Growth like that usually means more in-market accounts than an SDR team can research, write to, and follow up on by hand. Our AI SDR runs the research, writing, and follow-up autonomously, so coverage scales 3-5x per rep without adding headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for Stampli off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Most SDR teams burn the day on manual research and rewriting openers, so the best target accounts only get a thin touch. The fix is real volume and personalization at the same time, not trading one for the other.

I had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to three of Stampli's top accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them and the research behind each?
